coordinateConvention: Absolute source pixels, origin top-left; bounds half-open [x,y,w,h].
authoringStatus: Manually traced from source, reviewed via labeled overlay and enlarged crops.
policy: Source RGB remains unchanged. Polygon alpha selects subject. Separate contact collars and inferred backing are produced later.
excludedScope: Five house roofs, walls, doors and attached wall decorations
Fixed perimeter fences and root/rock/stream terrain
Tiny ambient flora without a distinct semantic owner
